title: Convergence of a least-squares splitting method for the Monge-Ampère equation
summary: We study the theoretical convergence of the nonlinear least-squares splitting method for the Monge-Ampère equation introduced in [1] in which each iteration decouples the pointwise nonlinearity from the differential operator and consists of a local nonlinear update followed by the solution of two sequential Poisson-type elliptic problems. While the method performs well in computations [2,3], a rigorous convergence theory has remained unavailable.
